objective: Bounded research-memory lookup, explicit reuse/refresh and version invalidation in the existing company harness.
reuse: accel_watch_definitions and occurrences for received public topic/profile
existing decision cases and pending-proposal invalidation
existing durable run traces, leases and server actor authority

lookup.authority: Bound to server actor/company/run, never accepts company authority from model arguments.
lookup.input: Received topic/profile and optional server-resolved entity identity; bounded lookup.
lookup.output: Company-scoped current research generation plus bounded knowledge records and excluded records with reasons. Every usable record has immutable native ID/version, evidence tuples, source dates, qualification, validity conditions and unknowns.

refresh.authority: Same run/company, only received public profiles, no arbitrary company query or arbitrary URL.
refresh.input: Typed reason such as missing/stale/changed/insufficient, lookup generation, consulted refs and stable operation key.
refresh.output: Completed/empty/partial/error/uncertain result with actual external call count and durable new refs/generation. No automatic retry for uncertain.

validateCurrent.input: Company authority held by server factory plus pinned research generation or precise dependency refs.
validateCurrent.output: Current version/result. Changes between lookup, provider, tool, prepare, publish or approve prevent use of the old dependent proposal.

proposedAgentBehavior: Offer a bounded lookup tool distinct from recall_decisions. A positive lookup must precede an admitted external research action.
Validate and project results positively. A foreign company, invalid hash/reference, unknown entity mapping, invalid dates or inconsistent version cannot enter model context.
Reuse only currently eligible records. Retain source quotations, hypotheses and applicability limits; do not promote model prose or a log into a company fact.
When complement/refresh is required, record the deterministic validity reason and actual consulted versions before invoking the authorized port.
A refreshed or changed source invalidates old in-run evaluations/proposals; the next analysis starts from the newly released generation.
Persist actual lookup/reuse/exclusion/research-decision outputs in correlated traces, durations and supplied usage only.
questionsForCanonicalDecision: Use a company research generation or precise referenced-version validation? A coarse generation is safe but can invalidate unrelated work.
How does qualification become eligible, and which current company/profile/entity fields are authoritative?
Should research retrieval be available to every question or only an explicit server-released research context?
What terminal output represents successful research reuse without a business proposal? Existing needs_input must not imply a failed retrieval.
How is the external refresh result retained across a process crash so a restart does not blindly repeat an uncertain call?
acceptanceSource: proposals/agent/RESEARCH-INTAKE.json R1 through R9; data-owner controlled scenario reused without HTTP to its fictional path

integrator: stale source to case/proposal dependency integration

limits: Proposal only. No shared contract, code, fixture, dependency, source store or runtime state changed.
No new scheduler, knowledge registry, service or provider.
A final architecture choice belongs to the integrator; this proposal does not override its framing.
